title: PUT /api/orders/cancel cancels any user's order - no buyer scoping (IDOR)
owner_hint: no CODEOWNERS entry; top committer: Aditya Mandaleeka; component: Ordering.API/
rationale: Adds an ownership check in CancelOrderCommandHandler.Handle: resolves the requester's Buyer via IBuyerRepository.FindAsync(IIdentityService.GetUserIdentity()) and denies (returns false) unless orderToUpdate.BuyerId matches. Scoped to the handler, not the repository, because internal domain-event flows also use OrderRepository.GetAsync without user context.
variants_checked: SetAwaitingValidation/SetStockConfirmed/SetPaid/SetStockRejected/Ship handlers share the unscoped GetAsync shape (separate findings); domain-event callers of OrderRepository.GetAsync intentionally left unscoped; IdentifiedCommand wrapper routes through the fixed handler.
bypass_considered: Foreign-order cancel, null sub claim, null BuyerId, and idempotent replay all fail closed; remaining same-shape gaps are the separate status-mutation findings.
test_note: New tests/Ordering.UnitTests/Application/CancelOrderCommandHandlerTest.cs: foreign buyer cannot cancel; order stays Submitted.
review_reason: In-scope root-cause ownership check in the handler itself; fails closed; no new surface; test follows existing MSTest/NSubstitute conventions.
